participants.text:
Dear Wesley,

Below is your special flavor of the masculine and feminine based on your birth chart.

This isn't your whole birth chart. It's just the dynamic of your inner marriage. But the inner marriage is really important as it reflects in all areas of our life, particularly in our relationships and how we put our work out into the world. It also speaks to what makes us feel sweet and happy and in alignment.

Small note: in Shamanic Astrology, the Sun Sign isn't the most important piece. It's more like the fuel you need to shine bright. As your Sun is in **Gemini**, that means you need all that Gemini goodness to feel your best. That said, your Venus is also in Gemini. So this part of you should not be denied!

**Here below is your special flavor of your inner marriage based on your birth chart:**

Your "feminine" side (represented by Venus) is in Gemini
Your "masculine" side (represented by Mars) is in Gemini

Here's the flavor and attitude of each:

Yes — a double Gemini! Your feminine and masculine share the same energy here, both flavored by Gemini's air.

## GEMINI — your feminine (represented by Venus)

I am Gemini, an air sign. I create the third gate of awareness, through which I teach the importance of the mind and ideas. I crave fresh experiences, change, fun, games, and imagination. I am versatile and curious and often play the comedian and perpetual youth. I am self-expressive through writing, speaking, or connecting to the divine muse through my many creative pursuits. I like to communicate, network, and bring news and information.

Gemini loves creativity and often loves child-like creative expression. They have a unique way of looking at the world and must have fresh experiences, change, fun, games, and imagination.

**Feminine archetypes:** The Eternal Youth, The Shapeshifter, The Divine Comedienne, The Creative Muse

## GEMINI — your masculine (represented by Mars)

I am Gemini, an air sign. I create the third gate of awareness, through which I teach the importance of the mind and ideas. I crave fresh experiences, change, fun, games, and imagination. I am versatile and curious and often play the comedian and perpetual youth. I am self-expressive through writing, speaking, or connecting to the divine muse through my many creative pursuits. I like to communicate, network, and bring news and information.

Gemini loves creativity and often loves child-like creative expression. They have a unique way of looking at the world and must have fresh experiences, change, fun, games, and imagination.

**Masculine archetypes:** The Trickster Magician, The Troubadour Minstrel, The Court Jester, The Coyote, The Fool, The Shape Shifter, The Information Networker, Hermes (Mercury)

## Right Relationship

In Tantra, the thing to look for is always if your masculine side is serving your feminine side so she can fully blossom. Also to make sure she has a lot of space for expression as she is primary!

The idea is that the more space the feminine has to express herself, the happier we are! More life force energy. More radiance. More ability to manifest what we want.

Everything tends to go better when our inner masculine serves our inner feminine. That said, as a man, both are hugely important and need honoring and full expression.

## Some questions to reflect on

Do you relate to one of these — Gemini or Gemini — more than the other? Who has gotten the most attention/airtime during your life?

Is your inner The Trickster Magician serving your inner The Eternal Youth?

(And whatever else comes to you about their relationship!)

Much love,
Amelia

So great to have you in my class 
Amelia Sunyata Perkins
